Q1: SELF_SIGNED_CONTRADICTION is not overly aggressive. It detects an internal contradiction (self_signed AND independent both true = two authorities under one field), not self-signing per se. An honest self-sign is written self_signed:true + independent:false and goes through NOT_INDEPENDENT, admitted by --allow-nonindependent - no punishment. The contradiction error is the field-level mirror of 'one id, one authority'. It removes authority, not admissibility - exactly R3. Keep as is.

Q2: the 'check format, not referenced-condition existence' boundary is correct and honestly scoped - condition ids are free-text prefixes ('C1: ...', 'C1 (B1, from Q2): ...') so existence needs prose parsing. Not a blocker: ADR already books it as Revisit-trigger item 2. Recommended follow-up (not this card): cross-load verdicts/<orig>.verdict.json conditions, normalize each to its ^[A-Za-z]+\d+ prefix ('C1 (B1, from Q2)' -> C1), assert the unblocks suffix is in that set.
